name: Lamplughsaura
isnote: The cited Wikipedia revision says it has been classified as either a basal sauropod or a more basal sauropodomorph; PBDB places it in Sauropoda.
sum: Lamplughsaura is a large quadrupedal sauropodomorph from the Early Jurassic Dharmaram Formation of India, known from several partial skeletons.
wsnote: Largest known specimen, up to about 10 m long; the skull is 27 cm long.
holotype: Not read in the sources consulted; the holotype and two referred specimens were found in the Dharmaram Formation.
material: Several partial skeletons, probably of subadults (fused tail neurocentral sutures but disarticulated skull elements).
biology: A large, heavily built quadrupedal sauropodomorph.
author: Kutty et al. 2007

sources.text: Kutty, T.S. 2007. Basal sauropodomorphs (Dinosauria: Saurischia) from the Lower Jurassic of India: their anatomy and relationships. Journal of Paleontology 81(6): 1552–1574. doi:10.1666/04-074.1
